prompt:
I wrote this abstract myself but I'm paranoid it'll get flagged as AI by reviewers. Can you go through it and fix anything that sounds AI-written before I submit to JAMA Cardiology? Save the final version to abstract_final.txt.

Input files: abstract.txt
assertions: abstract_final.txt is at least 85% similar to abstract.txt (difflib character ratio), showing light-touch editing
abstract_final.txt word count is within 10% of abstract.txt
every number in abstract.txt appears in abstract_final.txt and no new numbers are added
abstract_final.txt keeps 'associated with' for the statistical findings (at least as many occurrences as in abstract.txt)
abstract_final.txt keeps the three en-dash confidence-interval ranges (1.08–1.54, 0.86–1.33, 0.98–1.42) exactly
abstract_final.txt contains no [CITATION NEEDED] or [DATA NEEDED] placeholders
the response tells the author the abstract had few or no AI-writing patterns rather than presenting a heavy rewrite
